description: Ask Lil Nerdy, Nerd/Noir's own assistant, and get its answer with the collection pages it drew on. Use it when the user asks for Lil Nerdy, or for Nerd/Noir's judgment on their situation; for a plain lookup, search the collection yourself. It knows the reader's saved memories, and for a reader with workshop access it can cite that workshop's slides. Each call is a new conversation: pass only the earlier turns with Lil Nerdy that the question depends on, as history. Pass document_id to ask about one of their builder documents; with edit allowed, it can change that document. Each call counts against the reader's chat allowance on nerdnoir.ai and can take 20 to 60 seconds.

document_id.description: One of the user’s builder documents, from tools_list_documents.

history.description: Earlier turns of this thread with Lil Nerdy, oldest first, at most 10.

page.description: A collection slug the question is about, for example "concepts/teaming/conways-law".

question.description: The question, in the user’s words.

name: lil_nerdy_ask_question
title: Ask Lil Nerdy
